_description: KPI dependency map for manufacturing_iot — which downstream engines depend on each KPI/pillar. Used by configure_customer_kpis to warn when disabling load-bearing KPIs. One file per vertical (config/kpi_dependencies/<vertical>.json), matching config/economics/<vertical>.json and config/investment/<vertical>.json.
_generation_note: 2026-09-07: generated from config/manufacturing_iot_kpi_catalog.json directly. KPI selection: every KPI with impact=='high' in its own catalog entry (7 of 13 KPIs). This vertical has no adoption/engagement/partner concept (no channel/reseller motion, no software-onboarding concept — a physical-operations vertical, per the catalog's own pillar_roles_notes), so none of dc2_s's SaaS-parity metric names (TTFV/product_adoption/ticket_resolution_time) were relabeled here. 'metrics' uses the shared cross-vertical pillar_roles vocabulary from this catalog's own pillar_roles block (reliability/capacity/compliance/revenue/expansion); P3 (Quality & Defect Management) is explicitly left unmapped by the catalog itself ('no clean match... left unmapped rather than force-fit onto reliability, which this vertical already uses for a distinct concept'), so its entries use a vertical-local tag (quality_defect_management) and say so in the warning text. arc_classifier is attached only to the capacity-role pillar (P2 Production Throughput) and the expansion-role pillar (P5 Contract Renewals & Expansion, dual-mapped to revenue+expansion just like saas_premium's P5 — structurally the same pattern, not copied from it) — the same two roles dc2_s's own (preserved) file ties to arc_classifier, per config/power_of_1.json's attribution.signal_role_to_pillar_role and journeys/arc_classifier.py's rules (capacity_pressure -> stalled_deployment; expansion_intent/expansion_realized/advocacy -> expansion_champion/land_and_expand).
_source: config/manufacturing_iot_kpi_catalog.json (KPI names, weights, impact, pillar_roles, pillar_roles_notes) + config/power_of_1.json (attribution.signal_role_to_pillar_role) + journeys/arc_classifier.py (rule roles)

P1-KPI1.warning: Disabling P1-KPI1 (Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)) removes ROI engine's headline reliability-role signal — the standard composite uptime/performance/quality measure for this account's equipment

P1-KPI2.warning: Disabling P1-KPI2 (Unplanned Downtime Rate) removes a high-weight reliability-role signal from ROI engine

P2-KPI1.warning: Disabling P2-KPI1 (Units Produced vs Target) removes ROI engine's and arc classification's primary capacity-role throughput signal — the manufacturing_iot analogue of dc2_s's GPU Utilization, not a software-usage metric

P3-KPI1.warning: Disabling P3-KPI1 (Defect Rate) removes ROI engine's primary quality signal; Quality & Defect Management has no partner/expansion/adoption/engagement/reliability role in manufacturing_iot's shared vocabulary — left unmapped by design (reliability here is reserved for equipment uptime, a distinct concept — see the catalog's own pillar_roles_notes), so no other role absorbs this signal

P3-KPI2.warning: Disabling P3-KPI2 (First Pass Yield) removes a high-weight quality signal from ROI engine — same unmapped-pillar caveat as Defect Rate

P4-KPI1.warning: Disabling P4-KPI1 (Safety Incident Rate) removes ROI engine's primary compliance-role signal for this account

P5-KPI1.warning: Disabling P5-KPI1 (Contract Renewal Rate) removes ROI engine's and arc classification's headline revenue/expansion signal — Contract Renewals & Expansion plays both roles in manufacturing_iot (same pattern as saas_premium's Revenue & Growth), so this is the widest-blast-radius KPI to disable in this vertical

P1.warning: Disabling P1 (Equipment Uptime & Reliability) removes the reliability-role pillar from ROI engine's health-band computation — the highest-weighted pillar in this vertical (weight_l2 0.25)

P2.warning: Disabling P2 (Production Throughput) removes the capacity-role pillar from ROI engine and weakens arc classification's stalled_deployment / capacity_pressure evidence

P3.warning: Disabling P3 (Quality & Defect Management) removes this pillar from ROI engine; it has no clean match in manufacturing_iot's shared role vocabulary — left unmapped rather than force-fit onto 'reliability', which this vertical already uses for equipment uptime, a distinct concept (see the catalog's own pillar_roles_notes)

P4.warning: Disabling P4 (Safety & Compliance) removes the compliance-role pillar from ROI engine

P5.warning: Disabling P5 (Contract Renewals & Expansion) removes BOTH the revenue-role and expansion-role pillar from ROI engine and weakens arc classification's expansion_champion / land_and_expand evidence — manufacturing_iot conflates these two roles in one pillar, the same pattern saas_premium uses for Revenue & Growth
